title: Block Out Level 15 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 15 is a target-corner twin-tower puzzle. Open the right yellow lane, rotate the middle bars until the lower corner targets can leave, and only then spend the framed top corners.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 15 is a target-corner twin-tower puzzle. Open the right yellow lane, rotate the middle bars until the lower corner targets can leave, and only then spend the framed top corners.
landmarks: Block Out Level 15 is a target-corner twin-tower puzzle.
Open the right yellow lane, rotate the middle bars until the lower corner targets can leave, and only then spend the framed top corners.
The board mixes Blue, Yellow, Pink and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The right yellow lane starts the chain.
Lower corner targets leave before the upper framed corners.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Open the right yellow lane and use it to start rotating the middle red and pink blocks.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Keep the framed blue and yellow top corners parked while the center stack works downward.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Free the lower green target first, then the lower pink target once the bottom notch is no longer crowded.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Use the new bottom space to separate the central red and blue bars.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: After the lower corners are gone, release the framed upper-right yellow target.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with the framed upper-left blue target and the last red bar across the top.

failurePoints: Spending a top-corner frame before the lower targets are already moving.
Ignoring the right yellow lane and trying to rotate the middle stack in place.
